prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” attorney for every person — the right lawyer depends on your case details and what you personally need. I can help you find one, but first a few quick questions:

- What part of Chicago (zip code or neighborhood)?  
- How serious were the injuries (minor, moderate, catastrophic)?  
- Do you already have an insurance claim open?  
- Any language or budget preferences?  

While you answer, here are practical tips to find the best personal injury attorney for a Chicago car-accident claim and what to look for:

What to look for
- Focused experience: a lawyer who handles car-accident/personal-injury cases regularly (not a generalist).  
- Trial experience and a record of settlements/verdicts, especially for similar injury types.  
- Resources: ability to hire experts (medical, accident reconstruction), cover case expenses, and handle medical liens.  
- Contingency-fee arrangement (most PI lawyers work on contingency — no fee unless you recover) and clear explanation of costs/percentages.  
- Good communication: clear point of contact, expected response times, and regular updates.  
- Positive client reviews, peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell AV), and no disciplinary history (check Illinois ARDC).  
- Local court experience (familiarity with Cook County judges, local rules).

Where to look
- Lawyer directories: SuperLawyers, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Best Lawyers.  
- Local bar association referrals (Chicago Bar Association).  
- Word-of-mouth: ask friends/family who had similar claims.  
- Check disciplinary records at the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission (ARDC).

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases like mine (similar injuries, similar insurance issues)? Can you share outcomes?  
- Who in the firm will handle my case day-to-day?  
- What is your contingency fee and who pays out-of-pocket costs?  
- What is a realistic settlement range and timeline?  
- How do you handle medical liens and billing?  
- Can you provide client references?

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of well-regarded Chicago personal-injury firms based on reputation and specialties (I’ll need your zip code or neighborhood), or  
- Draft an email or questions to send to lawyers, or  
- Explain how settlements vs. trials typically work in Illinois.

Which would you prefer?
